_comment: Public repos for the #397 spike. 'The user' is each repo's main author, standing in for a user describing their own repo, named by GitHub login. The runner resolves a login to its git author emails at run time (the GitHub commits API, then a match on the account's display name in git log) and keeps that mapping only in the gitignored work dir. The owner's repos and reference facts are in the gitignored work dir (personal/eval_397/repos_private.json), never here.
